questions.question: Nehemiah served King Artaxerxes and looked sad. What did he say about the city where his fathers were buried?

answers.text: It lies in ruins and its gates are burned
Its people have all been carried away
Its temple has been torn to the ground

questions.question: When King Artaxerxes asked Nehemiah what he wanted, what did Nehemiah do before he answered?

answers.text: Prayed to the God of heaven
Asked the queen to speak for him
Asked for a night to think

questions.question: Nehemiah asked King Artaxerxes to send him to Judah, where his fathers were buried. What did he want to do there?
King Artaxerxes granted all of Nehemiah's requests for his trip to Judah. Why did Nehemiah say this happened?

answers.text: The gracious hand of his God was on him
The governors had promised to help him
The king owed him a favor
